explanation: Requested a cos(theta*) scan from -1 to +1 in 5 steps (-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1) at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg for the eta channel. Preflight check flagged the two endpoint values cos(theta*) = -1 and +1 as FAIL: EXCLURAD cannot evaluate exactly at the forward/backward poles. Applied the known, validated fix by clamping the endpoints to +/-0.999 (all interior points -0.5, 0, 0.5 were unaffected and already passed). Re-ran preflight on the corrected 5-point set: 5/5 PASS. Generated the EXCLURAD input file for the corrected scan.
